title: Analyzing Quality, Bias, and Performance in Text-to-Image Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from 88 gender-neutral or stereotype-probing text prompts (e.g., 'A person writing code', 'A nurse') and using human evaluators to classify the perceived gender of the subjects (Female, Male, or Uncertain) to calculate representation percentages and identify skewed distributions.

Generating images from 88 race-neutral or stereotype-probing text prompts and using human evaluators to classify the perceived race of the subjects (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic/Latino, or Uncertain) to calculate representation percentages and assess deviations from an even distribution.
